name: 07764 · W Long Branch, NJ
findings: ZIP 07764 (W Long Branch) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07764 (W Long Branch) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
